blocks.en: Abstract
blocks.zh: 摘要

blocks.en:
. As smart glasses and lightweight MR devices become increasingly practical, input remains a key challenge.
The bare palm is an always-available, tactile, and proprioceptively accessible surface, but it has neither an explicit coordinate system nor embedded touch sensing.
Prior on-palm systems typically expose isolated touch events, discrete regions, continuous trajectories, or task-specific gestures, limiting the palm’s ability to support precise selection and gesture manipulation through a common input representation.
We present PalmSpace, a wrist-worn infrared system that exposes mode-aware, body-referenced absolute input on the bare palm without per-user sensing calibration.
At the interaction level, PalmSpace jointly represents contact occurrence, interaction mode, and palm-referenced absolute location; at the model level, it learns these coupled outputs through a shared real-time representation.
In leave-one-participant-out evaluation with 17 participants, PalmSpace achieved 6.7 mm mean localization error, 98.9% contact detection accuracy, and 96.7% F1 for four-class interaction-state recognition.
User studies further demonstrated absolute pointing and dragging, eyes-free digit input, and representative multi-finger controls including scrolling and pinch-based map manipulation.
These results show that a morphologically variable bare palm can function as a transferable, mode-aware interaction surface.

blocks.en: 1. Introduction
blocks.zh: 1. 联合国 导言

blocks.en: Head-worn displays are again drawing attention as smart glasses and lightweight mixed-reality devices move closer to practical everyday use ( Lee and Hui, 2018 ; He et al., 2025a ) . Yet input remains a central challenge. Everyday wearable interaction demands techniques that are always available, socially unobtrusive, visually undemanding, and precise enough for both quick commands and fine-grained manipulation. While mice and touchpads remain the gold standard for precise pointing, they depend on dedicated hardware and stable external surfaces, making them poorly suited to lightweight head-worn use in mobile settings. Existing alternatives such as eye tracking, mid-air hand input, and compact wearable controllers avoid bulky external hardware, but often come with trade-offs such as visual demand, fatigue, lack of haptic feedback, or reliance on relative rather than absolute control ( Lee et al., 2024b ; Mayer et al., 2020 ; Qin et al., 2023 ; Kim et al., 2023 ; Nickel and Stiefelhagen, 2003 ; Shen et al., 2024 ; Kubo, 2022 ; Streli et al., 2024 ) . This makes on-body input particularly attractive for smart glasses: it keeps the interaction surface always available on the body itself while preserving tactile and proprioceptive cues.

blocks.en:
Among on-body input surfaces, the palm is especially promising: it is always available, naturally private, and rich in tactile and proprioceptive cues.
Yet unlike a touchscreen, the bare palm has neither an explicit coordinate system nor embedded sensing for determining when and how input occurs.
In terms of practicality, camera-based approaches are inherently viewpoint-dependent, making touch inference vulnerable to limited fields of view, self-occlusion, oblique viewing angles, and weak depth cues ( Mollyn and Harrison, 2024 ; He et al., 2025a ) . Systems augmented with projectors or depth sensors can improve sensing quality, but their additional bulky hardware substantially reduces deployment practicality ( Harrison et al., 2011 ; Dezfuli et al., 2012 ) . Even wearable solutions often still rely on user-specific calibration or training, while offering limited robustness in touch detection and localization ( Stearns et al., 2018 ; Wang et al., 2015b ; Zhang et al., 2016 ; Wang et al., 2015a ) .
More fundamentally, prior systems tend to expose only one layer of input semantics: discrete touch zones, isolated touch events, continuous positions, or task-specific gestures ( Wang et al., 2015a ; Stearns et al., 2018 ) . Most also lack explicit modeling of multi-finger modes alongside absolute position.
As a result, the palm is still treated more as a collection of sparse events than as a structured interaction space.
What is missing is a common representation of palm interaction that jointly encodes three tightly coupled properties: whether contact occurs, where it occurs in body-referenced absolute coordinates, and what interaction mode it belongs to.
For example, in smart-glasses map interaction, users may first use touch detection and absolute localization to select or drag toward a region of interest, and then switch to multi-finger input for zooming and rotation.
Representing these properties together allows precise targeting and gesture control to coexist on the same bare-palm surface.
blocks.zh:
在体上输入面中,手掌特别有希望:手掌总是可用的,自然是私人的,并有丰富的触觉和自发的提示.
然而,与触摸屏不同,光手掌既没有明确的坐标系统,也没有嵌入式感测,以确定何时以及如何进行输入。
在实用性方面,基于相机的方法本质上是视线依赖的,这使得触摸推论易受到有限视域,自我包容,偏斜取景角度和弱深度提示(Molyn and Harrison, 2024; He等, 2025a.)的影响. 配有投影仪或深度传感器的系统可以提高感能质量,但其额外的大块硬件会大大减少部署实用性(Harrison等人,2011年;Dezfuli等人,2012年)。 甚至可穿戴的解决方案也常常仍然依赖用户特有的校准或训练,同时在触摸检测和本地化方面提供有限的强性(Sterns等,2018;Wang等,2015b;Zhang等,2016;Wang等,2015a.).
更根本的是,先前的系统往往只暴露出一层输入语义:离散的触觉区,孤立的触觉事件,连续位置,或特定任务手势(Wang等,2015a;Stearns等,2018). 大多数国家还缺乏与绝对位置相伴的多指模式的明确模型。
因此,棕榈仍然更多地被当作是零星事件的集合,而不是结构化的互动空间.
所缺少的是棕榈相互作用的共同代表,它共同编码了三个紧密相接的属性:接触是否发生,在身体参考绝对坐标中发生,以及它属于什么相互作用模式.
例如,在智能-玻璃映射交互中,用户可能首先会使用触摸检测和绝对本地化来选择或拖入感兴趣的区域,再切换到多指形输入来进行缩放和旋转.
把这些属性结合在一起,可以精确地瞄准和手势控制,在同一光帕表面共存。

blocks.en:
To this end, we present PalmSpace , a wrist-worn system that provides unified on-palm input at two complementary levels. At the interaction level, it exposes contact semantics, interaction mode, and palm-referenced absolute location through a common representation. At the model level, it learns interaction state and location through a shared multi-task representation rather than independent task-specific pipelines.
We instantiate this formulation with a wrist-worn infrared sensing setup, a palm-normalized coordinate space that transfers across users without per-user sensing calibration, and a real-time multi-task Transformer. Together, these components support precise single-finger input and representative multi-finger gesture control on the same bare-palm surface.
blocks.zh:
为此,我们提出PalmSpace, 这是一个手腕缝合系统,提供两个互补层面的统一palm输入. 在相互作用层面,它通过共同的表达方式,暴露出接触语义,交互模式,和棕榈参考绝对位置. 在模型层面,它通过共享的多任务代表而不是独立的任务特定管道来学习交互状态和位置.
我们用一个手腕折射红外感应装置, 一个掌上正常的坐标空间,在用户之间传输, 而不进行每个用户的感应校正, 一个实时的多任务变换器。 这些组件加在一起支持精确的单指输入和具有代表性的多指手势控制在同一光帕表面.

blocks.en: In offline evaluation using leave-one-participant-out cross-validation, PalmSpace achieved a mean absolute localization error of 6.7 mm, 98.9% accuracy for binary contact detection, and a 96.7% F1-score for four-class interaction-state recognition. An additional ablation on unseen outdoor data shows that the unified model improves both localization and touch recognition over independently trained task-specific models while requiring only one deployed model.

blocks.en: To evaluate PalmSpace in realistic settings, we conducted user studies of Fitts’s Law pointing, eyes-free digit entry, handwriting, list navigation, and map manipulation, together with outdoor evaluations under daytime and low-light conditions.
blocks.zh: 为了在现实环境下评价棕榈空间,我们进行了Fitts定律指向、无眼数字输入、笔迹、列表导航和地图操纵的用户研究,以及白天和低光条件下的户外评价。

blocks.en: 2.1. Input Methods for Head-Worn Interaction
blocks.zh: 2.1. 头字互动输入方法

blocks.en:
Head-worn interaction requires input techniques that are efficient, easy to use, private, socially acceptable, and suitable for eyes-free use in daily activities ( Xu et al., 2025 ; Yoon et al., 2016 ) . At the same time, they must support both diverse commands and sufficiently precise control.
Gaze-based interaction remains a dominant modality, using AR/MR headsets ( Lee et al., 2024b ; Wang et al., 2024 ; Yan et al., 2024 ) or smartphone cameras ( Mayer et al., 2020 ; Qin et al., 2023 ) for interaction. However, it suffers from the “Midas Touch” problem ( Jacob, 1991 ) , ocular fatigue ( Lee et al., 2024b ) , and lower precision than traditional mice ( Majaranta and Bulling, 2014 ) . Robust gaze input also often depends on dedicated eye tracking or rich sensing configurations, which are difficult to support in lightweight head-worn settings ( Lee et al., 2024b ; Wang et al., 2024 ; Yan et al., 2024 ) .
Mid-air hand interaction offers an intuitive alternative, including pointing-direction input ( Kim et al., 2023 ; Fang et al., 2024 ; Hu et al., 2010 ; Vogel and Balakrishnan, 2005 ; Li et al., 2026 ) and fingertip estimation ( Romaniak et al., 2020 ; Malik and Laszlo, 2004 ) . Yet, these methods depend on line of sight and provide little haptic feedback, complicating fine motor control and increasing fatigue during prolonged use ( Cheng et al., 2022 ) .
Physical devices provide tangible feedback, but come with different trade-offs. Pen-based inputs offer high precision, but are less portable because they require an additional handheld device and often rely on relative input with mobile devices or external tracking systems ( Lüthi et al., 2022 ; Matulic et al., 2020 ; Hwang et al., 2013 ; Romat et al., 2021 ; Maierhöfer et al., 2024 ) . Smart rings improve portability ( Kubo, 2022 ; Kienzle and Hinckley, 2014 ; Kienzle et al., 2021 ; Oh et al., 2017 ; Shen et al., 2024 ) , yet often sacrifice absolute positioning and wearing comfort. Smartphones ( Babic et al., 2018 ; Debarba et al., 2012 ; Pietroszek et al., 2014 ; Pietroszek et al., 2015 ; He et al., 2023 ; Li et al., 2024 ; Yu et al., 2025 ) and smartwatches ( Katsuragawa et al., 2016 ) similarly support portable interaction, with different capabilities and constraints in sensing and control.
blocks.zh:
头-头-头-头交互需要高效,易用,私人,社会上可接受的输入技术,并适合在日常活动中无眼使用(徐等,2025;尹等,2016. 同时,它们必须支持多样化的命令和足够精确的控制。
基于Gaze的相互作用仍然是一种主导模式,使用AR/MR耳机(Lee等,2024b;Wang等,2024;Yan等,2024)或智能手机相机(Mayer等,2020;秦等,2023)进行相互作用. 然而,它遇到了“Midas touch”问题(Jacob,1991年),视力疲劳(Lee等,2024年b),精度低于传统的小鼠(Majaranta和Buring,2014年)。 强视输入还经常依赖于专用眼跟踪或丰富的感知配置,在轻量级头骨环境下难以支持(Lee等,2024b;Wang等,2024;Yan等,2024).
中空相接提供了一个直观的可选方法,包括指向输入(Kim等,2023;Fang等,2024;Hu等,2010;Vogel和Balakrishnan,2005;Li等,2026)和指尖估计(Romanik等,2020;Malik和Laszlo,2004)。 然而,这些方法依赖于视线,很少提供随机回馈,使精细的机动控制复杂化,并且在长时间使用期间越来越疲劳(Cheng等,2022年)。
物理装置提供有形的反馈,但有不同的取舍。 以纸币为基础的输入提供了高精度,但因需要额外的手持设备而不那么便携,而且往往依靠移动设备或外部跟踪系统的相对输入(Lüthi等,2022;Matulic等,2020;Hwang等,2013;Romat等,2021;Maierhöfer等,2024)。 智能环能改善可携带性(Kubo,2022;Kienzle和Hincley,2014;Kienzle等,2021;Oh等,2017;Shen等,2024),但常牺牲绝对定位并穿戴舒适. 智能手机(Babic等,2018年;Debarba等,2012年;Pietroszek等,2014年;Pietroszek等,2015年;He等,2023年;Li等,2024年;Yu等,2025年)和智能手表(Katsuragawa等,2016年)同样支持便携式交互,在感知和控制方面具有不同的能力和制约.

blocks.en: 2.2. On-Hand Input Methods
blocks.zh: 2.2. 手持输入方法

blocks.en:
Prior research has explored a range of techniques for turning the hand or palm into an input surface.
For smart-glasses, however, two challenges remain central: whether palm input can be sensed with a lightweight and wearable setup, and whether the palm can support versatile, structured interaction.
blocks.zh:
先前的研究探索了将手或棕榈转化为输入表面的一系列技术.
然而,对于智能眼镜来说,两个挑战仍然是中心问题:棕榈投入能否被轻量级和可穿戴的设置所感知;棕榈是否能够支持多功能,结构化的互动.

blocks.en:
Practical sensing methods. Early systems demonstrated the feasibility of palm interaction by augmenting the environment or the body with additional sensing hardware.
Kohli and Whitton ( Kohli and Whitton, 2005 ) used magnetic tracking to monitor the index finger on the opposite palm, but the method was prone to drift and required careful calibration.
OmniTouch ( Harrison et al., 2011 ) , WatchSense ( Sridhar et al., 2017 ) , and LumiWatch ( Xiao et al., 2018 ) combined depth sensing and projection to support on-body touch interaction.
While these systems showed the promise of interactive skin, they depended on depth cameras, projectors, or bulky mounted hardware, which increase cost, size, and deployment burden ( Mollyn and Harrison, 2024 ) .
Other wearable sensing approaches reduced some of this hardware overhead. SkinTrack ( Zhang et al., 2016 ) used RF-based triangulation for continuous 2D tracking, but required user calibration and was sensitive to skin conditions.
TouchCam ( Stearns et al., 2018 ) achieved high touch recognition accuracy by instrumenting the finger, while HandPad ( Lu et al., 2024 ) relied on attachments on both wrist and fingers.
Although effective, these solutions introduce instrumentation on the fingers or body that reduces practicality.
More recently, head-mounted MR systems such as EgoTouch ( Mollyn and Harrison, 2024 ) and Palmpad ( He et al., 2025a ) have shown that finger-palm contact can be detected using egocentric cameras.
However, such approaches remain inherently viewpoint-dependent: touch inference is unstable under self-occlusion, oblique viewing angles, or when the hand leaves the camera view,
as evidenced by Palmpad’s reliance on the Quest 2’s multi-camera API for localization.
Taken together, prior work has explored multiple sensing routes, yet practical palm interaction for smartglass use remains constrained by bulky hardware, finger instrumentation, calibration requirements, or viewpoint dependency.

blocks.en:
From touch events to absolute palm interaction. Beyond sensing, a second challenge is how the palm is represented as an input space.
Several systems have leveraged the palm as a proprioceptively accessible surface for eyes-free interaction ( Bergström and Hornbæk, 2019 ) .
PalmRC ( Dezfuli et al., 2012 ) and PalmType ( Wang et al., 2015a ) , for example, showed that the palm can support remote control and text entry without visual attention.
However, PalmType relied on discrete infrared proximity sensors and was limited to detecting predefined key regions rather than continuous coordinates.
PalmGesture ( Wang et al., 2015b ) moved toward continuous input using an infrared camera and laser line projector, but required users to define the interaction area by touching four corners and imposed strict posture constraints on finger orientation.
These limitations illustrate that many prior systems still treat the palm either as a set of discrete touch zones or as a calibrated surface requiring explicit setup, rather than as a robust absolute interaction space.
For head-worn use, however, practical palm interaction requires more than knowing that a touch occurred; it also requires reliable absolute localization on the palm surface without per-user calibration.
blocks.zh:
从触摸事件到绝对棕榈互动. 除了感知之外,第二个挑战是如何将棕榈作为投入空间。
多个系统将棕榈作为无眼互动的可自行进入地表(Bergström和Hornbæk,2019年)。
例如PalmRC(Dezfuli等,2012年)和PalmType(Wang等,2015年a)显示,掌上可以支持遥控和文字输入而无需视觉注意.
不过,棕榈 类型依赖于离散红外相近传感器,仅限于探测预先确定的关键区域,而不是连续坐标。
PalmGesture(Wang等,2015b)使用红外相机和激光线投影仪向连续输入移动,但要求用户通过触摸四个角来定义交互区域,并对指向施加了严格的姿态限制.
这些限制表明,许多先前的系统仍然将棕榈视为一组离散的触摸区或需要明确设置的校准地表,而不是一个强大的绝对互动空间。
然而,对于头-头-头用,实用的棕榈交互需要的不仅仅是知道发生了触摸;它还需要在棕榈表面可靠地绝对本地化而无需每个用户校正.

blocks.en:
From single-finger input to expressive multi-finger interaction. A further limitation of existing on-skin interfaces lies in interaction expressiveness.
Most compact wearable palm-input systems primarily support single-finger tapping or pointing ( Wang et al., 2015a ; Stearns et al., 2018 ; Zhang et al., 2016 ; Xiao et al., 2018 ) .
By contrast, studies have shown that users naturally transfer multi-finger gesture metaphors, such as pinching and two-finger sliding, from smartphones to skin surfaces ( Weigel et al., 2014 ) .
Systems that support simultaneous multi-point input, such as iSkin ( Weigel et al., 2015 ) and SkinMarks ( Weigel et al., 2017 ) , typically require stretchable overlays or electronic tattoos attached directly to the skin, which reduce tactile sensitivity and complicate everyday deployment. Projection-based on-skin interaction systems can support multi-point input, but generally require bulky sensing hardware ( Harrison et al., 2011 ) .
In the realm of compact, wrist-worn devices (e.g., SkinTrack ( Zhang et al., 2016 ) , LumiWatch ( Xiao et al., 2018 ) ), signal ambiguity and occlusion have largely restricted interactions to single-finger pointing or discrete tapping.
As a result, prior work has largely left compact palm interfaces at the level of sparse input events, without explicitly modeling richer interaction modes in a unified way.
In particular, existing systems rarely address together three essential dimensions of palm interaction: whether contact occurs, where it occurs in absolute palm coordinates, and which interaction mode it belongs to, such as single-finger versus multi-finger input.
blocks.zh:
从单指输入到表达多指交互. 对现有皮肤上接口的进一步限制在于交互表达.
大多数可穿戴的棕榈投入系统主要支持单指敲打或指尖(Wang等,2015a;Stearns等,2018;Zhang等,2016;Xiao等,2018.).
相比之下,研究表明,用户会自然地将多指手势比喻从智能手机转移到皮肤表面(Weigel等,2014年),如捏取和双指滑动等.
支持同时多点输入的系统,如iSkin(Weigel等,2015年)和SkinMarks(Weigel等,2017年),一般需要可伸展的上盖或直接附在皮肤上的电子纹身,这降低了触觉敏感性并使得日常部署复杂化. 基于皮肤的投影互动系统可以支持多点输入,但一般需要大量感知硬件(Harrison等,2011. ).
在紧凑领域,腕织装置(如SkinTrack (Zhang等,2016年),Lumi Watch (Xiao等,2018年)),信号模糊和被封禁在很大程度上限制了单指指或离散接接接接的相互作用.
因此,之前的工作在很大程度上将紧凑的棕榈界面留在了稀有输入事件层面,而没有以统一的方式明确模拟更丰富的互动模式.
特别是,现有系统很少将棕榈互动的三个基本维度一起处理:接触是否发生,发生在绝对棕榈座标中,以及它属于哪一种互动模式,如单指与多指输入.

blocks.en:
Summary and Research Gap. Table 1 summarizes how PalmSpace compares with prior on-palm interaction systems in terms of sensing setup, calibration requirements, localization capability, interaction expressiveness, and evaluation scope.
Taken together, prior work has improved palm input sensing, but still falls short of making the palm a practical and general interaction space. Existing systems typically address only part of the problem—such as touch detection, localization, or a specific gesture family—while often relying on bulky hardware, per-user calibration, or sustained visual attention. As a result, palm input remains fragmented into isolated events and task-specific pipelines rather than functioning as a unified interaction space. PalmSpace addresses this gap by jointly modeling contact existence , absolute on-palm location , and interaction mode in a lightweight, calibration-free wrist-worn system.

综合起来,先前的工作改善了对棕榈投入的感知,但仍然未能使棕榈成为一个实际和一般的互动空间。 现有系统通常只处理问题的一部分,例如触摸探测、本地化或特定的手势家族,同时往往依赖大量硬件、每个用户的校准或持续的视觉关注。 因此,棕榈投入仍然被分散为孤立的事件和特定任务的管道,而不是作为一个统一的互动空间发挥作用. PalmSpace通过联合建模接触存在,绝对在palm上的位置,以及在轻量级,无校正的手腕活化系统中的互动模式来解决这一缺口.

blocks.en: 3. PalmSpace Overview
blocks.zh: 3个 棕榈空间概览

blocks.en: 3.1. Proof-of-Concept Hardware
blocks.zh: 3.1. 概念硬件证明

blocks.en:
PalmSpace is a wrist-mounted infrared vision system for sensing bimanual finger-to-palm interaction.
It is designed to capture fine-grained palm contact cues and support three tasks: touch detection, touch localization, and gesture recognition.
At this stage, we implement PalmSpace as a proof-of-concept prototype to validate sensing feasibility and system design under stable imaging conditions.
blocks.zh:
棕榈空间(PalmSpace)是一个手腕架红外视觉系统,用于感知双人指相接的相互作用.
它旨在捕捉细纹棕榈接触提示并支持三项任务:触摸检测,触摸本地化,和手势识别.
在现阶段,我们实施PalmSpace作为概念的验证原型,在稳定的成像条件下验证遥感可行性和系统设计.

blocks.en:
Why a wrist viewpoint? A wrist-worn camera provides a direct and stable view of the hand and palm during interaction, making it well suited for contact sensing.
Compared with head-mounted viewpoints ( Mollyn and Harrison, 2024 ; Streli et al., 2023 ) or external tracking APIs ( Dupré et al., 2024 ) , the wrist perspective more directly captures the contact region and is therefore better suited for subtle touch sensing ( Xi et al., 2026 ; Wang et al., 2026 ) .
More importantly, unlike most prior wrist-mounted vision systems, which mainly focus on single-hand pose estimation or finger tracking ( Hu et al., 2020 ; Xi et al., 2026 ; Kim et al., 2012 ; Li et al., 2025 ) , PalmSpace targets bimanual finger-to-palm interaction, a fundamentally different task that requires sensing touch events, touch locations, and interaction gestures rather than only posture.
blocks.zh:
为什么要看手腕? 手腕折叠相机在相互作用时提供手和手掌的直观而稳定的取景,使其非常适合接触感知.
相较于头架式观点(Molyn and Harrison, 2024; Streli等, 2023)或外部跟踪API(Dupré等, 2024),手腕式视角更直接地捕捉到接触区,因此更适合微妙的触摸感知(Xi等, 2026;Wang等, 2026).
更重要的是,与大多数先前手腕挂起的视觉系统不同,这些系统主要侧重于单手姿势估计或指向跟踪(Hu等,2020;Xi等,2026;Kim等,2012;Li等,2025)。 空间目标为双指相接互动,这是一项根本不同的任务,需要感知到触觉事件,触觉位置,互动手势,而不仅仅是姿态.

blocks.en:
Prototype design. Our wristband (Fig. 2(a) ) integrates an infrared camera (OV2710) with a 3.5 mm wide-angle lens (100 ∘ FOV), capturing 1920 × \times 1080 infrared images at 30 FPS.
Ten 850 nm infrared LEDs are embedded in a 3D-printed casing to provide active illumination, enabling robust infrared imaging that reduces ambient light interference and reveals clear palm details.
To reduce self-occlusion during wrist bending, we introduce a 120 ∘ mechanical flip-up structure, similar to the design of imoo Z7 ( imoo, 2024 ) , allowing the camera to maintain visibility across a wide range of hand poses.
The device is worn on the dorsal wrist in standby mode and rotated to the inner wrist during sensing.
The prototype measures 2.4 cm in height and 3.2 cm in width from the side, and weighs 22 g excluding cables.
At this stage, PalmSpace is implemented as a wired prototype for reliable image capture and synchronization; future wireless integration is feasible given commercial wearable camera systems ( Tonsen et al., 2020 ; Inc., 2023 ; Wristcam Inc., 2020 ) .

10个850纳米红外LED被嵌入了3D打印的外壳以提供活性发光,使强力红外成像能够减少环境光干扰并揭示出清晰的掌状细节.
为了减少手腕弯曲时的自闭,我们引入了120 QQ机械翻转结构,类似于Imoo Z7 (imoo, 2024)的设计,使相机在广泛的手姿上保持能见度.

blocks.zh: 3.2. Versatile互动模式

blocks.en:
To realize the versatile interaction space introduced earlier, PalmSpace structures the palm as a unified interaction space rather than a collection of isolated touch events. We organize this space along two dimensions: finger configuration (single-finger vs. multi-finger) and contact surface (palm vs. finger surface), enabling both precise input and expressive manipulation.
For single-finger input, we define three natural posture variants—Left Yaw (LY), Vertical Touch (VT), and Right Yaw (RY)—based on the finger’s yaw angle relative to the palm (Fig. 3 - 3 ). These variants capture common on-body touch orientations while allowing pitch to vary freely (Fig. 3 ), and can occur on both the palm and finger surfaces.
For multi-finger input, PalmSpace supports two palm-based modes, Scroll and Pinch (Fig. 3 and 3 ), whose larger and smoother contact area better supports stable multi-finger control. Together, these modes turn the palm into a structured interaction space for symbolic input, precise spatial control, and compound manipulation.

blocks.en: 4. PalmSpace Method
blocks.zh: 4.四. 棕榈空间方法

blocks.en:
PalmSpace is built on a simple premise: applications should receive palm input through a common representation rather than disconnected touch, localization, and gesture pipelines.
PalmSpace therefore unifies input at two levels. At the interaction level, it couples discrete state semantics with continuous absolute location on the palm. At the model level, it learns both outputs through a shared multi-task representation from wrist-worn images.
blocks.zh:
PalmSpace是建立在一个简单的前提上:应用程序应该通过共同的表示而不是断开的触摸,本地化,和手势管道接收掌上输入.
因此,PalmSpace在两个层面上统一输入。 在相互作用层面,它将离散状态语义与棕榈上的持续绝对位置相接. 在模型层面,它通过手腕成像的共享多任务表现来学习两种输出.

blocks.en: 4.1. Unified Touch Modeling Framework
blocks.zh: 4.1. 统一触摸模型框架

blocks.en:
The interaction representation integrates three tightly coupled properties:
(1) contact-state classification , which distinguishes non-contact from active touch;
(2) interaction-mode recognition , which identifies whether the current interaction corresponds to single-finger input or a supported multi-finger mode; and
(3) touch localization , which estimates the absolute interaction position in a palm-normalized coordinate space.
Instead of deploying independent task-specific models, PalmSpace learns these properties within one end-to-end model, enabling real-time interaction without per-user sensing calibration.
This unified formulation structures the palm as an interaction space with hierarchical interaction awareness.
Single-finger input supports precise pointing and target selection, while multi-finger input supports richer manipulations such as scrolling and pinch-based control.
In our implementation, the model predicts four interaction states: Non-contact , Single-finger , Scroll , and Pinch .
These four states jointly encode both contact presence and interaction mode.
At the same time, the model regresses the 2D location of the primary interaction point, thereby coupling discrete interaction semantics with continuous spatial input.
blocks.zh:
互动表现包括三个紧密相通的特性:
(1) 联系状态分类,区分非接触和主动接触;
(2) 交互-模式识别,确定当前交互是对应单指输入还是支持多指模式;以及
(3)触地化 , 估计出棕榈正态坐标空间中的绝对交互位置.
PalmSpace没有部署独立的任务特定模型,而是在一个端到端模型中学习这些属性,使得没有每个用户感应校正的实时交互成为可能.
这种统一的配方结构将棕榈作为具有分级互动意识的互动空间.
单指输入支持精确指向和靶向选择,多指输入支持更丰富的操作,如滚动和按键控制.
在我们的实施中,该模型预测了四个相互作用: 非接触型,单指相接,相接相接相接
这四个状态共同编码了联系存在和互动模式.
同时,模型还倒退出主相互作用点的2D位置,从而将离散的相互作用语义与连续的空间输入相接.

blocks.en: 4.2. Palm-Normalized Touch Representation
blocks.zh: 4.2. 棕榈-非正常触摸代表

blocks.en:
A central challenge of touch localization on the palm is the large anatomical variation across users.
Directly regressing fingertip positions in absolute image or physical coordinates makes predictions highly sensitive to hand size differences.
As a result, even the same semantic touch location on the palm (e.g., the tip of the middle finger) can correspond to substantially different coordinates across users.
In our dataset, the gap between the smallest and largest hands reaches 4.5 cm, causing significant bias for direct coordinate regression.
To address this issue, PalmSpace represents touch locations in a palm-relative normalized coordinate system.
The horizontal coordinate is centered at the wrist midline and normalized by palm breadth, while the vertical coordinate is referenced to the palm base and normalized by palm length.
This maps the palm into a standardized space with lateral range [ − 0.5 , 0.5 ] [-0.5,0.5] and longitudinal range [ 0 , 1 ] [0,1] , shifting localization from user-specific absolute prediction to proportional position estimation within the palm.
This representation improves cross-user consistency, supports calibration-free learning, and enables the learned interaction space to transfer naturally across devices with different screen sizes.
blocks.zh:
触摸掌上局部化的一个中心挑战是不同用户间的巨大解剖变异.
在绝对图像或物理坐标中直接倒回指尖位置使得预测对手相大小差异高度敏感.
因此,就连掌上相同的语义触取位置(如中指尖端)也可以对应到各用户之间大相径庭的坐标.
在我们的数据集中,最小和最大手之间的相距已达4.5厘米,导致直接坐标回归的重大偏差.
为了解决这一问题,PalmSpace在棕榈相通的坐标系统中代表了触地点。
水平坐标以手腕中线为中心并按棕榈宽度实现常态化,而垂直坐标则参照到棕榈底部并按棕榈长度实现常态化.

To instantiate the unified formulation above, we design a multi-task Transformer that jointly predicts interaction state and touch location from wrist-worn images (Fig. 4 ).
The model contains three components: a visual feature extractor, a lightweight Transformer interaction module, and two task-specific prediction heads.

blocks.en: 5. Offline Evaluation
blocks.zh: 5 (韩语). 离线评价

blocks.en: This section evaluates PalmSpace for joint touch mode recognition and touch localization, covering the dataset and validation protocol, detailed results across contact regions and interaction types, and ablation studies of key design components.
blocks.zh: 本节评价PalmSpace用于联合触摸模式识别和触摸本地化,涵盖数据集和验证协议,跨接触区的详细结果和相互作用类型,以及关键设计组件的衰减研究.

blocks.en: 5.1. Data Collection
blocks.zh: 5.1. 数据收集

blocks.en: 5.1.1. Pipeline.

To evaluate PalmSpace, we collected a comprehensive dataset of finger-to-palm interactions covering the variations shown in Fig. 3 .
Each sample was annotated with four labels: (1) touch state (touch vs. non-touch), (2) gesture category (Single, Scroll, or Pinch), (3) interaction coordinates on the hand surface, and (4) palm size for coordinate normalization.
Our setup used a wrist-mounted IR camera for model input and an overhead mirrorless camera for ground-truth generation.
To recover physical interaction coordinates, we defined a planar calibration area around the hand with AprilTag markers ( Olson, 2011 ) and mapped the overhead view to the physical coordinate system via homography estimation.
Fingertip keypoints were tracked in the overhead view using MediaPipe ( Zhang et al., 2020 ) and transformed into metric palm-plane coordinates as localization ground truth.
This markerless design avoids attaching sensors or reflective markers, reducing visual artifacts while preserving realistic bare-hand interaction.
Details are provided in Appendix B .

为了评价PalmSpace,我们收集了一套全面的指对相相互作用的数据集,涵盖图3所示的变化。
每个样本被附加了四个标签:(1)触摸状态(指与非触摸状态),(2)手势类别(单相,斯克罗尔,或平克),(3)手表上的互动坐标,以及(4)用于协调正常化的棕榈大小.
我们的设定使用手腕挂式IR相机进行模型输入,并使用高架无镜相机进行地面真实生成.
为了恢复物理交互坐标,我们用AprilTag标记(Olson,2011年)定义了手周围的平面校正区域,并通过测谱估计将俯视图映射到物理坐标系统。
使用MediaPipe(Zhang等,2020年)在俯仰视图中跟踪了指尖键点,并被转换为作为本地化地面真相的公制棕榈平面坐标.
这种无标记的设计避免了附加传感器或反射标记,减少了视觉文物,同时保留了现实的光手互动.

blocks.en: 5.1.2. Participants and Procedure.
blocks.zh: 5.1.2. 与会者和程序。

blocks.en:
We recruited 17 right-handed volunteers (11 male, 6 female; aged 20–34 years, M = 24.4 M=24.4 , S ​ D = 3.3 SD=3.3 ).
To ensure anthropometric diversity, we recorded hand dimensions: hand length ranged from 155 to 200 mm ( M = 181.1 M=181.1 , S ​ D = 12.0 SD=12.0 ), and hand breadth ranged from 65 to 85 mm ( M = 77.8 M=77.8 , S ​ D = 5.2 SD=5.2 ), consistent with prior reports ( Khan, 2017 ) .
The study included 9 sessions: 6 single-finger sessions (2 areas × \times 3 modes), 2 multi-finger sessions (Scroll and Pinch), and 1 non-contact session.
Single-finger data were collected on both the palm and finger regions, whereas multi-finger gestures were collected on the palm only.
Participants performed gestures naturally without strict pose constraints to better reflect realistic touchpad-like interactions.
The non-contact session included hovering and random hand motions as negative samples for touch detection.
After removing samples with ground-truth tracking failures, the final dataset contained 63,903 images from 17 participants, including 35,727 single-finger samples, 11,645 multi-finger samples, and 16,531 non-contact samples.
Each participant completed the procedure in about 30 minutes.

blocks.en: 5.2. Validation Setup

blocks.en:
We adopt a leave-one-participant-out (LOPO) cross-validation strategy.
Given N = 17 N=17 participants, the dataset is partitioned into N N folds. In each fold, data from N − 1 N-1 users are used for training, while the remaining user serves as the unseen test set.
This subject-independent protocol rigorously evaluates the model’s generalization ability to new users.

Gesture recognition. As summarized in Table 2 , PalmSpace achieves 98.9% binary touch detection accuracy. For multi-class gesture recognition, Non-Touch, Single-Touch, Scroll, and Pinch obtain F1 scores of 97.9%, 97.2%, 88.1%, and 97.4%, respectively, yielding an overall F1 of 96.7%.

PalmSpace achieves an overall MAE of 6.7 mm over all valid touch samples (Table 2 ). Localization remains accurate for both Single-Touch (6.1 mm) and Scroll (6.3 mm), suggesting that the model handles planar finger motion robustly. Even for Pinch, which involves stronger self-occlusion between the thumb and index finger, the error remains within 10.6 mm under cross-user evaluation.

Compared with a ResNet-50 encoder, a model without the decoder, and a U-Net baseline, the full PalmSpace architecture achieves the best zero-shot outdoor performance (Table 3 (b)). blocks.en: 6. User Study of Single-Finger Interaction
blocks.zh: 6. 用户对单指手指相互作用的研究

blocks.en:
This section presents an evaluation of PalmSpace for single-finger interaction across both indoor and outdoor settings.
We first conducted two indoor studies to examine input efficiency under realistic everyday lighting conditions.
The first focused on pointing and dragging performance using a Fitts’ law task, while the second examined eyes-free digit entry performance, with particular attention to the benefits of absolute positioning and proprioception.
We then assessed the robustness of PalmSpace in representative outdoor conditions, including daytime use under uncontrolled lighting and nighttime use in extremely low-light environments.
blocks.zh:
本节介绍对PalmSpace在室内外环境进行单指交互的评价。
我们首先进行了两项室内研究,以审查在现实的日常照明条件下的投入效率。
第一组侧重于利用Fitts的法律任务来指点和拖取性能,而第二组则审查无眼数字入门性能,特别注意绝对定位和自主的好处。
然后,我们评估了棕榈空间在具有代表性的室外条件下的稳健性,包括在无控制的照明下白天使用和在极低灯光环境中夜间使用。

blocks.en: 6.1. Input Methods and Participants
blocks.zh: 6.1. 投入方法和参与者

blocks.en:
PalmSpace was compared with a smartphone touchscreen baseline, as both support absolute positioning over a similar size of interaction area.
We recruited 12 right-handed participants (3 female; age 19–24, M = 21.2 M=21.2 ), all familiar with touchscreen use and none with prior experience using PalmSpace.
To reflect realistic usage, the indoor study was conducted in 4 indoor settings with different ambient lighting conditions: a morning office, a night meeting room, an evening lab, and an afternoon apartment.
Participants used their dominant index finger for input. For PalmSpace, they used the non-dominant hand without individual calibration; for the touchscreen baseline, they held the smartphone in the non-dominant hand.
blocks.zh:
PalmSpace被比作智能手机触摸屏基线,因为两者都支持在类似大小的互动区域上绝对定位.
我们征聘了12名右撇子参与者(3名女性;19至24岁;M=21.2 M=21.2),他们都熟悉触摸屏的使用,没有一位以前使用棕榈空间的经验。
为了反映实际使用情况,室内研究在四个室内环境照明条件不同的场所进行:一个早间办公室、一个晚间会议室、一个晚间实验室和一个下午公寓。
与会者用主要的食指进行投入。 对于"PalmSpace",他们使用非主控手而无需单独校正;对于触摸屏基线,他们将智能手机握在非主控手.

blocks.en: 6.2.1. Task and Procedure
blocks.zh: 6.2.1. 任务和程序

blocks.en:
We conducted a Fitts’ law study to evaluate pointing and dragging performance.
In both conditions, interaction was performed with identical visual feedback presented on a separate display (Fig. 6(a) ).
To ensure a fair comparison, the smartphone screen did not display any graphical interface and served only as a coordinate-sensing surface.
Thus, both conditions used the same interaction mechanism and external visual feedback.
For both methods, normalized input coordinates were mapped to the same GUI, ensuring identical control-display ratios and perceived target sizes across conditions.
blocks.zh:
我们进行了Fitts法律研究,以评估指向和拖取业绩。
在这两种情况下,互动都是在单独的显示(图6(a))上提供的相同的视觉反馈。
为确保公平比较,智能手机屏幕没有显示任何图形界面,仅作为坐标感应面.
因此,两个条件都使用了相同的互动机制和外部视觉反馈.
对于这两种方法,普通输入坐标被映射到同一个图形用户界面上,确保了相同的控制-显示比率和不同条件的可感知目标大小。

blocks.en:
In each trial, the GUI displayed a yellow target and a green target area.
The yellow target had a randomly sampled diameter of 20–40 mm, while the green target area had a fixed diameter of 60 mm.
The two circles were separated by a random distance of 80–200 mm.
Participants first moved the cursor to the yellow target. Once selected, the target turned red, indicating the start of the dragging phase.
Participants then dragged the red circle until it was fully enclosed within the green target area.
We recorded hit time , defined as the time from target onset to target acquisition, and drag time , defined as the time from the start of dragging to successful placement.
Each participant completed 5 11-trial blocks per method; excluding the first trial of each block as a warm-up yielded 50 valid trials per method.
The same sequence of target parameters was used across conditions to control task difficulty.
Participants practiced until performance stabilized, and short breaks were provided between blocks.
blocks.zh:
在每次试验中,图形用户界面都显示出一个黄色目标和一个绿色目标区域.
黄色目标随机取样直径为20-40毫米,而绿色目标区域固定直径为60毫米.
两个圆圈由80-200毫米的随机相距相隔.
与会者首先将光标移到黄色目标. 一旦选中,目标会变成红色,表明拖曳阶段的开始.
随后,与会者将红圈拖至绿地目标区被完全封闭.
我们记录了命中时间,定义为从目标开始到目标获取的时间,并拖动时间,定义为从拖入到成功放置的时间。
每名学员每人完成5个11个审判区块;不包括每个区块的首次审判,因为每次加热产生50个有效审判。
不同条件都使用了相同的目标参数序列来控制任务难度.
参与者练习到性能稳定为止,区块之间提供短暂的间歇.

blocks.en: 6.2.2. Result

We analyzed 1,200 valid method-level trials in total (600 per method).
To verify consistency with Fitts’ law, we modeled the relationship between movement time and index of difficulty using I ​ D = log 2 ⁡ ( 2 ​ D W ) ID=\log_{2}(\frac{2D}{W}) .
As shown in Fig. 6(b) and 6(c) , PalmSpace achieved performance close to the touchscreen baseline.
For total, hit, and drag times, PalmSpace yielded 1572.2 ms, 797.7 ms, and 774.4 ms, respectively, while the touchscreen yielded 1361.6 ms, 642.5 ms, and 719.2 ms.
Notably, drag time showed no significant difference between PalmSpace and the touchscreen ( F 1 , 11 = 1.30 , p = 0.279 F_{1,11}=1.30,p=0.279 ).
This is particularly surprising because, despite the palm being an uneven and compliant surface, PalmSpace still enabled manipulation performance comparable to a gold-standard touchscreen.
blocks.zh:
我们总共分析了1 200起有效的方法级试验(每起方法600起)。
为了验证与Fitts定律的一致性,我们用 I D = log 2 = (2 D W ) ID = (\frac{2D}{W})来模拟移动时间与难度指数之间的关系。
如图6(b)和图6(c)所示,PalmSpace实现了接近触摸屏基线的性能.
棕榈空间总共产生1572.2米、797.7米和774.4米;而触摸屏则产生1361.6米、642.5米和719.2米。
值得注意的是,拖曳时间显示棕榈空间与触摸屏之间没有显著区别(F 1, 11 = 1.30;p = 0.279 F _{ 1, 11 }= 1.30;p = 0.279)。
这特别令人吃惊,因为尽管棕榈是一个不均匀和符合要求的地表,但棕榈空间仍然能够像金标准触摸屏那样进行操纵。

blocks.en:
Further analysis of hit time versus ID (Fig. 6(c) ) showed that the main difference arose during target acquisition, likely due to the palm’s less stable surface.
However, once the target was acquired, dragging performance remained stable and comparable across methods.
Overall, these results demonstrate that PalmSpace supports efficient pointing and dragging, with performance approaching that of a touchscreen even on the naturally irregular surface of the palm.
blocks.zh:
对打出时间与ID的进一步分析(图6(c))表明,在取得目标时出现了主要差异,原因可能是棕榈表面不太稳定。
然而,一旦获得目标,拖累性能仍然保持稳定,而且各种方法之间具有可比性。
总的来说,这些结果表明,PalmSpace支持高效的指向和拖取,性能接近触摸屏,甚至在棕榈表面自然不规则.

blocks.en: 6.3. Study 2: Digit Input Evaluation
blocks.zh: 6.3. 研究2:数字投入评价

blocks.en: 6.3.1. Task and Procedure
blocks.zh: 6.3.1. 任务和程序

blocks.en:
We evaluated PalmSpace’s support for eyes-free absolute input using a digit entry task.
Because discrete digit entry requires direct selection of fixed spatial locations, it serves as a natural test of absolute pointing on the palm.
blocks.zh:
我们评价了PalmSpace对使用数字输入任务的无眼绝对输入的支持。
由于离散数字输入需要直接选择固定空间位置,因此它成为了对棕榈上绝对指向的自然测试.

blocks.en:
As shown in Fig. 6(a) , we mapped twelve finger knuckles (excluding the thumb) to a keypad-like layout, with the three knuckles of the little finger corresponding to digit 0.
Since the perceived boundaries and absolute positions of knuckle regions can vary slightly across individuals, participants first touched the designated knuckle areas so that their personalized finger layout could be recorded.
This registered the application-specific mapping between anatomical regions and digit labels; it did not retrain or calibrate the PalmSpace sensing model.
For the touchscreen baseline, we used a keypad layout with the same size and spatial arrangement as PalmSpace.
Participants then completed five rounds of random 10-digit entry under eyes-free conditions.
The touchscreen baseline followed the same procedure and used the same digit sequences.
blocks.zh:
如图6(a)所示,我们把十二指指指(不包括拇指)绘制成键盘式布局,小指的三指指与数字0相对应。
由于感觉到的接指区域的界限和绝对位置会因个人而略有不同,与会者首先触及指定的接指区域,以便记录其个性化的接指布局。
这记录了解剖区和数字标签之间的应用图;它没有重新训练或校正棕榈空间感测模型。
对于触摸屏基线,我们采用了与PalmSpace相同的大小和空间安排的键盘布局.
学员随后在无眼条件下完成了5轮随机10位入场.
触摸屏基线遵循相同的程序,并使用相同的数字序列.

blocks.en: 6.3.2. Result

As shown in Fig. 6(d) , PalmSpace significantly outperformed the touchscreen, achieving an overall digit-entry accuracy of 93.71% versus 74.86% ( W = 2.5 , p < .01 W=2.5,p<.01 ).
We further analyzed transitions between consecutive inputs as Identical , Adjacent , and Non-adjacent , referring to repeated, neighboring, and spatially separated keys, respectively.
PalmSpace remained stable across all three transition types (all above 94%), whereas touchscreen performance declined substantially as transition distance increased.
These results show that PalmSpace effectively supports eyes-free absolute input by leveraging the palm’s intrinsic proprioceptive structure.
Detailed digit-level results are provided in Appendix C .
blocks.zh:
如图6(d)所示,PalmSpace的成绩大大超过触摸屏,总体数字输入精度为93.71%与74.86%(W=2.5,p <.01 W=2.5,p <.01)。
我们进一步分析了连续输入的相同、相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相

这些结果显示,PalmSpace通过利用棕榈内在自制结构,有效支持无眼绝对输入.

blocks.en: 6.4. Outdoor Robustness Validation
blocks.zh: 6.4. 户外强力验证

blocks.en: To assess robustness beyond indoor settings, we evaluated PalmSpace in two representative outdoor scenarios: daytime use under uncontrolled lighting and nighttime use in extreme low-light conditions. We recruited 13 new volunteers with no prior experience using the system: 7 performed random palm touches in diverse daytime settings, including parks, streets, and direct sunlight, and 6 performed the same Fitts’ law task as in Sec. 6.2 at night under ambient illuminance below 5 lux. The daytime model results are reported with the other ablations in Table 3 (b); detailed data-collection and training protocols are provided in Appendix E .
blocks.zh: 为了评估室内环境以外的稳健性,我们在两种有代表性的室外情景中评价了PalmSpace:在不受控制的照明下白天使用和在极低灯光条件下夜间使用。 我们招募了13名没有使用系统经验的新志愿者:7名在公园、街道和直接阳光等不同日间环境中进行随机棕榈触摸,6名在夜间在环境光照下5个奢侈度以下进行与Sec. 6.2相同的Fitts法律任务。 在表3(b)中报告日间模型结果,并在附录E中提供详细的数据收集和培训规程。

blocks.en: In daytime testing, the original indoor-trained model achieved a mean absolute error of 9.6 mm; fine-tuning reduced this to 6.8 mm and improved touch detection F1 to 98.7%, indicating robust accuracy under challenging lighting and background conditions. At night, geometric error could not be measured because the external RGB camera used for ground-truth annotation was ineffective in near-dark environments. We therefore evaluated usability using the same indoor Fitts’ law task and task completion time as the primary metric. The average nighttime completion time was 1509.03 ms (SE = 25.49), comparable to the 1572.2 ms observed indoors, suggesting that PalmSpace remains practically usable in near-dark real-world conditions. Overall, these results show that PalmSpace supports efficient single-finger interaction both indoors and across representative outdoor conditions.
blocks.zh: 在日间测试中,最初的室内训练型号实现了9.6毫米的平均绝对误差;微调后将这个误差降至6.8毫米并改进了触摸检测F1至98.7%,表明在有挑战性的照明和背景条件下的精确度很强. 在夜间,几何误差无法被测量,因为用于地-真实注释的外置RGB相机在近暗环境中无效. 因此,我们用同样的室内Fitts法律任务和任务完成时间作为主要衡量标准来评估可用性。 平均夜间完成时间为1509.03毫秒(SE = 25.49),与室内观测到的1572.2毫秒相当,这表明棕榈空间在近黑暗现实世界条件下仍然可以实际使用. 总体而言,这些结果显示,PalmSpace既支持室内又跨有代表性室外条件的高效单指交互.

blocks.en: 7. Evaluation of Multi-Finger Gestures
blocks.zh: 7. 对多指手势的评价

blocks.en: To evaluate PalmSpace in lightweight smart-glasses-oriented scenarios, we conducted a task-based user study on two representative operations in head-worn interfaces: List Navigation and Map Manipulation . These tasks represent lightweight UI browsing and continuous spatial adjustment, respectively. Accordingly, we evaluated two palm-based multi-finger interactions: Scroll for discrete directional navigation and Pinch for continuous zooming and rotation.
blocks.zh: 为了评价PalmSpace在以轻量级智能玻璃为主的情景,我们对头-头-头-头接口的两个代表性操作进行了基于任务的用户研究: 列表导航和地图操纵 . 这些任务分别代表轻量级UI浏览和连续空间调整. 因此,我们评价了两个多指掌的相互作用: 滚动用于离散方向导航和Pinch用于持续放大和旋转.

blocks.en: 7.1. Interaction Logic and State Management
blocks.zh: 7.1. 互动逻辑和国家管理

blocks.en:
The interaction logic is governed by a finite state machine (FSM), shown in Fig. 7(a) . Based on the model output, the system maintains four states: Idle , Single-Touch , Scroll Mode , and Pinch Mode . The system enters the corresponding interaction mode after classification and returns to Idle upon release.
In Scroll Mode , directional intent is estimated from the displacement vector between the start and end frames of a gesture sequence. The displacement angle is mapped to one of four directions ( up , down , left , right ), while the displacement magnitude suppresses small unintended motions. This design targets lightweight smart-glasses browsing tasks such as list and menu navigation.
In Pinch Mode , the predicted interaction point relative to the palm center is mapped to two continuous control channels: radial displacement for zooming and angular displacement for rotation. This enables compact two-degree-of-freedom control for smart-glasses map manipulation. To keep the main paper concise, the exact transfer functions, gain settings, and angle wrapping compensation are provided in the Appendix. Here, we focus on whether this design provides sufficient controllability, stability, and usability for application-oriented tasks.
blocks.zh:
相互作用逻辑由有限状态机器(FSM)来管理,如图7(a)所示. 基于模型输出,系统维持了四个状态:Idle , Single-Touch , Scroll Mode 和 Pinch Mode . 系统在分类后进入相应的交互模式,发布后返回Idle.
在 Scroll mode 中,方向意图是从手势序列的起始和末端框架之间的移位矢量来估计的. 流离失所角度分布在四个方向(上、下、左、右)中的一个方向上,而流离失所的程度抑制了小型的意外动议。 这种设计针对轻量级智能眼镜浏览任务,如列表和菜单导航.
在 Pinch mode 中,相对于掌心的预测交互点被映射到两个连续的控制通道:用于缩放的射线移位和用于旋转的角移位. 这使得对智能眼镜地图的操作可以进行紧凑的双度自由控制. 为了保持主纸的简洁,附录中提供了准确的转移功能,增益设置,和角度包装补偿. 在此,我们侧重于这种设计是否为面向应用的任务提供了充分的可控性、稳定性和使用性。

blocks.en: 7.2. Experimental Setup
blocks.zh: 7.2. 实验设置

blocks.en: We recruited 12 participants (age: M = 25.0 M=25.0 , S ​ D = 1.87 SD=1.87 ; balanced gender), all with normal or corrected-to-normal vision. Before the formal study, each participant completed a 5-minute tutorial on gesture triggering and task requirements. Formal trials began only after participants reported being comfortable with the gestures.
blocks.zh: 我们招募了12名参与者(年龄:M=25.0 M=25.0,S D=1.87 SD=1.87;平衡性别),所有参与者都具有正常或正对正对正视的视力. 在正式研究之前,每位参与者完成了关于手势触发和任务要求的5分钟辅导. 正式审判是在参与者报告对姿态感到舒服之后才开始的。

blocks.en: 7.2.1. Apparatus and Tasks
blocks.zh: 7.2.1. 设备和任务

blocks.en: The study comprised two tasks corresponding to the smart-glasses scenarios above. Since current lightweight smart glasses do not support screen projection for customized interfaces, we used an external display and adjusted the viewing distance to approximate smart-glasses display conditions.
blocks.zh: 这项研究包括两项任务,与上述智能眼镜方案相对应。 由于目前的轻量级智能眼镜不支持屏幕投影用于定制界面,因此我们使用外部显示并调整了取景距离,以近似智能眼镜显示条件.

blocks.en: Task 1: List Navigation. This task assessed discrete directional control with Scroll gestures. In each trial, participants performed the gesture corresponding to one of four randomized visual prompts ( up , down , left , right ). Each direction was repeated 5 times, yielding 20 trials per user. This task simulates list and menu navigation in smart-glasses interfaces.
blocks.zh: 任务1:列表导航. 这项任务用滚动手势评估了离散方向控制。 在每次审判中,参与者都做了相当于四个随机视觉提示(上,下,左,右)之一的手势. 每个方向重复5次,每个用户进行20次试验。 这个任务模拟了智能眼镜界面中的列表和菜单导航.

blocks.en:
Task 2: Map Manipulation. This task assessed continuous two-degree-of-freedom control with Pinch gestures. We used an abstract compound docking task to capture the core demands of smart-glasses map interaction while reducing confounds from rendering latency and scene complexity. The interface showed a semi-transparent Target State and a solid User Cursor , both rendered as a “Circle + Arrow” glyph. Target scale was randomly sampled from 0.5 × 0.5\times to 3.0 × 3.0\times , and target rotation from 0 ∘ 0^{\circ} to 360 ∘ 360^{\circ} . Each participant completed 20 trials, yielding 240 trials in total. Participants aligned the cursor to the target using Pinch gestures. A trial was successful only if the cursor stayed within a 10% scale margin and a 10 ∘ 10^{\circ} angular margin for 1.0 s. Scale and rotation were controlled through the same Pinch interaction.
We recorded Completion Time , Final Scale Error , Final Rotation Error , and Overshoots , where overshoots denote the number of times the controlled value exceeded the target and then reversed for correction during a trial.
blocks.zh:
任务2:地图操纵. 这项任务用平克的手势评估了连续的两度自由控制. 我们用抽象的复合物对接任务来捕捉智能眼镜地图交互的核心需求,同时减少渲染延缓性和场景复杂性带来的困惑. 界面显示一个半透明的目标状态和一个固态的用户光标,两者都作为"Circle + Arrow"glyph提供. 目标比例从0.5×0.5\时随机抽取到3.0×3.0\时随机抽取,目标自0××0×Circ}到360××360×Circ}随机抽取. 每位参与者完成了20起审判,共产生240起审判。 与会者使用平克手势使光标与目标一致。 只有光标保持在10%的比值和1.0s的相角相角相间,试验才成功。 规模和旋转是通过相同的平克相互作用来控制的.
我们录制了"完成时间","最终缩放出错","最终旋转出错"和"过度射击",其中过量射击表示控制值超过目标的次数,然后在一次试验中倒转以进行校正.

blocks.en: 7.3. Results

For Task 1 ( List Navigation ), the system achieved an overall recognition accuracy of 97.08% across 240 trials. As shown in Fig. 7(b) , confusion was minimal and evenly distributed, suggesting that Scroll provides reliable directional input for list browsing tasks.
blocks.zh: 就任务1(清单导航)而言,该系统在240次试验中的总体识别精度达到97.08%。 如图7(b)所示,混淆程度最低,分布均匀,说明Scroll为列表浏览任务提供了可靠的方向输入.

blocks.en: For Task 2 ( Map Manipulation ), participants completed the 240 compound-docking trials in an average of 7.90 s. Rotation stabilized faster than scaling ( T r ​ o ​ t = 3.59 T_{rot}=3.59 s vs. T s ​ c ​ a ​ l ​ e = 4.31 T_{scale}=4.31 s), suggesting faster target acquisition in the rotational channel. However, rotation also showed a higher overshoot rate than scaling (0.96 vs. 0.55), indicating more frequent corrective adjustments. In contrast, scaling was slower but more stable. Despite this trade-off, both channels supported precise final control: the final scale error was 4.4%, and the final rotation error was 6.1 ∘ , both within the task tolerance. Overall, these results suggest that PalmSpace supports both reliable discrete input and effective continuous zoom-and-rotate control, making it suitable for representative smart-glasses interactions such as list browsing and map manipulation.
blocks.zh: 对于任务2( Map Manipulation ),参与者平均以 7.90 s. 旋转比缩放(T r o t = 3.59 T_{rot}=3.59 s vs. T s. s s. s. c a l e = 4.31 T_{scale}= 4.31 s)快地完成了240个复合堆积试验,表明旋转通道中的目标获取速度更快. 然而,轮换率也比比例(0.96对0.55)高,表明更正调整更加频繁。 相比之下,缩小速度较慢,但更为稳定。 尽管有这种取舍,两道都支持精确的最终控制:最终的尺度误差为4.4%,而最终的旋转误差为6.1 QQ,两者均在任务可容忍度范围内. 总体而言,这些结果表明,PalmSpace既支持可靠的离散输入,又支持有效的连续缩放和旋转控制,使其适合具有代表性的智能眼镜交互,如列表浏览和地图操纵等.

blocks.en: 8. Discussion
blocks.zh: 8. 讨论情况

blocks.en: 8.1. Usability Feedback
blocks.zh: 8.1. 可用性反馈

blocks.en:
We assessed PalmSpace’s perceived usability using the System Usability Scale (SUS) ( Brooke and others, 1996 ) . All participants involved in the user study completed the SUS. Using a 6-point scale, PalmSpace received a mean SUS score of 72.5 ± \pm 14.0 (median = 70.0, IQR = 16.0), corresponding to a “Good” adjective rating on the interpretive scale proposed by Bangor et al. ( Bangor et al., 2008 ) .
Item-level responses suggested strong perceived ease of use, learnability, and confidence, with generally low perceived complexity and awkwardness.
blocks.zh:
我们用系统使用度表(SUS)评估了PalmSpace的可使用性(Brooke等,1996年)。 所有参与用户研究的参与者都完成了SUS. PalmSpace采用6分比例法,得到平均SUS分72.5±\pm 14.0(中间值=70.0,IQR=16.0),与Bangor等提出的解释性比例尺上的"好"形容词评级相对应. (Bangor等,2008年).
项目层面的答复表明,人们强烈认为使用方便、易学和自信,但一般认为复杂性和尴尬程度较低。

blocks.en:
Interview feedback further contextualized these results. One participant (female, 25) noted, “PalmSpace remained comfortable even during prolonged wear and did not interfere with other ongoing activities. I did not need to pay much attention to my hand, and could stay focused on the screen, which made the experience feel relaxed.”
Another participant (male, 22) remarked, “The gestures were easy to learn and felt like an almost seamless transition from touchscreen interaction, even though the palm is less flat than touchscreen surface.” Notably, one outdoor-study participant (male, 23) was able to complete the study while mountaineering and camping in snowy conditions, suggesting promising robustness beyond controlled indoor environments.
The results suggest that PalmSpace provides a usable and learnable interaction experience.
blocks.zh:
访谈反馈进一步说明了这些结果的背景。 一位与会者(女性,25人)指出,“即使在长时间穿戴期间,PalmSpace仍然很自在,而且不影响其他正在进行的活动。 我并不需要多注意我的手,而且可以把注意力放在屏幕上,这使经验感到放松。 “
另一位与会者(男性,22人)说,“这些手势很容易学习,并且感觉从触摸屏相互作用中几乎无缝地过渡,尽管手掌不如触摸屏表面平坦。” 值得注意的是,一名户外学习参与者(男性,23人)在上山和在多雪的条件下露营时完成了研究,表明在受控制的室内环境之外有希望的强健性。
结果表明,PalmSpace提供了一个可用和可学习的互动经验。

blocks.en: 8.2. Design Space
blocks.zh: 8.2. 设计空间

blocks.en:
PalmSpace enables a versatile design space for on-palm interaction, moving beyond isolated touch events toward a more structured interaction paradigm. This design space is defined by the three dimensions of our unified touch modeling framework: contact state, absolute spatial localization, and interaction modality.
Together, these dimensions allow designers to construct a rich vocabulary of eyes-free, calibration-free interactions.
In doing so, PalmSpace expands the dimensionality and functional scope of prior on-palm input techniques, making the palm an expressive interactive surface.
blocks.zh:
PalmSpace为棕榈互动提供了多功能设计空间,超越了孤立的触摸事件而转向了更有条理的互动范式. 这个设计空间是由我们统一触摸模型框架的三个维度来定义的:接触状态,绝对空间定位,以及相互作用模式.
这些维度共同使设计者能够构建出丰富的无眼,无校正的相互作用词汇.
在此过程中,PalmSpace扩展了前作上palm输入技术的维度和功能范围,使棕榈成为了表现式互动面.

blocks.en: Dimension 1: Contact state. It distinguishes spatial exploration from command execution. Non-contact supports hovering and exploration, while contact marks active input. It also supports different temporal forms of interaction, including brief taps and sustained dragging or drawing.
blocks.zh: 维度1:接触状态. 它区分了空间探索和命令执行. 非接触支持徘徊和探索,而接触标记为活性输入. 它还支持不同的时间互动形式,包括简短的自带和持续的拖曳或绘图.

blocks.en: Dimension 2: Absolute spatial localization. It enables precise selection of coordinates on the palm, supporting both discrete target selection and continuous movement across the palm surface. It can also degrade into relative control, similar to a touchpad.
blocks.zh: 尺寸 2: 绝对空间定位. 它能够精确地选择棕榈上的坐标,支持离散的目标选择和横跨棕榈表面的持续移动。 它也可以被降解成相对控制,类似于触控板.

blocks.en: Dimension 3: Interaction modality recognition. It distinguishes between single-finger and multi-finger interaction modes, substantially increasing expressive power and enabling more complex compound operations.
blocks.zh: 维度3:互动模式识别. 它区分了单指和多指交互模式,大大提高了表达力并使得复合操作更为复杂.

blocks.en:
We illustrate this design space through three levels of interaction.
First, combining active contact (Dim. 1), absolute localization (Dim. 2), and single-finger tracking (Dim. 3) supports reliable eyes-free text entry (Sec. 6.3 , Fig. 8 ), handwriting (Appendix C.3 , Fig. 8 ), drawing or editing (Fig. 8 and Fig. 8 ), Whac-A-Mole interaction (Fig. 8 ), and attribute control such as volume sliders (Fig. 8 ).
These examples show how PalmSpace supports symbolic input and precise spatial control through single-finger interaction.
Second, combining active contact (Dim. 1), displacement-based mapping (Dim. 2), and multi-finger tracking (Dim. 3) supports the two representative operations studied in Sec. 7 : discrete multi-finger gesture input and continuous compound gesture control, such as zooming, rotation, and sliding.
These examples demonstrate PalmSpace’s support for manipulation through multi-finger interaction.
Third, PalmSpace also enables cross-modal composition , where users combine or transition between single/multi-finger within the same task.
Such composition supports more complex operations, as illustrated by map interaction (Fig. 8 ) and page browsing and control (Fig. 8 ).
Precise single-finger positioning can be combined with subsequent multi-finger manipulation to accomplish richer workflows.
Please refer to our supplementary video for all examples.
blocks.zh:
我们通过三个层次的互动来说明这种设计空间。
首先,结合主动接触(Dim. 1),绝对本地化(Dim. 2),和单指跟踪(Dim. 3),支持可靠的无眼文字条目(Sec. 6.3,图8),笔迹(Appendix C.3,图8),绘图或编辑(图8和图8),Whac-A-Mole交互(图8),以及卷滑动等属性控制(图8).
这些例子显示了PalmSpace如何通过单指交互支持符号输入和精确的空间控制.
其次,结合活性接触(Dim. 1),以移动为主的映射(Dim. 2),多指跟踪(Dim. 3),支持 Sec. 7所研究的两个代表性操作:离散多指手势输入和连续复合手势控制,如缩放,旋转和滑动.
这些例子表明PalmSpace支持通过多指交互操作.
第三,PalmSpace还能够实现跨模式构成,用户在同一任务范围内在单指/多指之间组合或过渡。
这种构成支持更复杂的操作,例如地图交互(图8)和页面浏览与控制(图8.
精准的单指定位可以与后期多指操纵相结合来完成更丰富的工作流程.
请参看我们关于所有例子的补充录像。

blocks.en: 8.3. Limitations and Future Work
blocks.zh: 8.3. 限制和今后的工作

blocks.en:
Beyond current findings, several natural directions can further extend the system. While the leave-one-participant-out evaluation indicates encouraging robustness across users, the present dataset still captures only part of the variation encountered in real-world hand morphology, appearance, and usage conditions.
Expanding the participant pool and systematically examining factors such as accessories, fingernail appearance, and a wider range of finger-specific behaviors would help further characterize performance across diverse users and contexts. In addition, the current multi-finger interaction model adopts a robust proxy-based design centered on the primary interaction point. This formulation is well suited to the scrolling and pinch-based tasks studied here, and supports stable, practical control on the compact palm surface. Building on this foundation, future work can explore richer representations of finger articulation and denser hand-surface modeling to support more fine-grained multi-finger interaction in a wider range of tasks.
blocks.zh:
除了目前的调查结果之外,若干自然方向可以进一步扩大该系统。 虽然 " 一个参与者 " 退出评价表明,用户的稳健性令人鼓舞,但目前的数据集仍然只掌握了现实世界手表形态、外观和使用条件中遇到的部分变化。
扩大参与者人才库,系统地审查附件、指甲外观和更广泛的指状行为等因素,将有助于进一步说明不同用户和背景的业绩。 此外,目前的多指交互模型采用了以主交互点为核心的稳健的代理设计. 这种配方非常适合此处所研究的滚动和按键任务,并支持对紧凑的棕榈表面进行稳定而实际的控制. 在这个基础上,今后的工作可以探索更丰富的指向表达和更密集的手表模型,支持在更广泛的任务中更精细地多指交互.

blocks.en:
The current system is implemented as a tethered prototype, a design choice that prioritizes sensing stability and synchronized evaluation in this initial study. This setup enables a controlled validation of the unified touch modeling framework and demonstrates the feasibility of versatile on-palm interaction. Looking ahead, an important next step is to move toward a more compact and self-contained wearable implementation.
Integrating lightweight cameras into wireless wearables is already a mature direction, as demonstrated by commercial devices such as Pupil Labs Neon ( Tonsen et al., 2020 ) , TapXR ( Inc., 2023 ) , and Wristcam ( Wristcam Inc., 2020 ) .
In a preliminary mobile deployment test, dynamic INT8 quantization and TorchScript reduced model size by 3.7 × \times and accelerated inference by 2.7 × \times , reaching nearly 30 FPS on a Redmi Turbo 4 smartphone.
Future work will therefore focus on on-device deployment through model compression and system-level optimization, including quantization, pruning, and adaptation to lower-power embedded platforms, while maintaining the interaction quality achieved by the current prototype.
blocks.zh:
目前的系统作为系好原型实施,这一设计选择在本次初步研究中优先考虑了感知稳定性和同步评价. 这种设置能够对统一的触摸模型框架进行有控制的验证,并显示多功能相上互动的可行性。 展望未来,下一个重要步骤是朝着更加紧凑和自成一体地执行方向迈进。
将轻量级相机整合到无线可穿戴设备中已经是一个成熟的方向,例如学生实验室Neon(Tonsen等,2020年),TapXR(股份有限公司,2023年)和Wristcam(Wristcam Inc.,2020年)等商业设备就证明了这一点.
在一次初步的移动部署测试中,动态INT8量子化和火炬Script将模型大小缩小了3.7×××分秒并加速了2.7××分秒的推论,在Redmi Turbo 4智能手机上达到了近30个FPS.
因此,今后的工作将侧重于通过模型压缩和系统层面优化进行安装部署,包括量化,推跑,并适应更低功率的嵌入式平台,同时保持当前原型实现的互动质量.

blocks.en: 9. Conclusion
blocks.zh: 9. 国家 结论

blocks.en: PalmSpace turns the bare palm into a mode-aware, body-referenced interaction surface by jointly representing touch contact, absolute on-palm location, and interaction mode. Its unified model supports cross-user inference without per-user sensing calibration while avoiding separate state-recognition and localization pipelines. Cross-user evaluation and user studies demonstrate absolute pointing, eyes-free digit input, and representative multi-finger controls such as scrolling and map manipulation, highlighting the potential of unified bare-palm input for future head-worn interaction.

blocks.en: Appendix A Implementation Details
blocks.zh: 附录A 实施情况

blocks.en: A.1. Network Configuration
blocks.zh: A.1. 网络配置

blocks.en: The visual encoder is initialized from a pre-trained ViT-B/16 model ( Dosovitskiy et al., 2020 ) . For single-channel input, the image is replicated to three channels before being fed into the backbone. The backbone output is reshaped into a spatial feature map and projected by a 1 × 1 1\times 1 convolution to a feature dimension of d model = 256 d_{\text{model}}=256 . Absolute two-dimensional sinusoidal positional embeddings are then added to preserve spatial structure for localization.
blocks.zh: 视觉编码器由经过预训的Vit-B/16模型(多索维特斯基等,2020年)初始化. 对于单通道输入,图像被复制到三个通道后再被输入到骨干. 骨干输出被重塑为空间地物映射图,由1×1 1\times 1 演化为d模型=256 d_{\text{model}}=256的地物维度. 然后再添加绝对的二维sinoidal位置嵌入来保存空间结构以进行局部化.

blocks.en: The interaction module is a lightweight Transformer composed of three encoder layers. Each layer uses 8 attention heads, a feed-forward expansion ratio of 4, GELU activation, and a dropout rate of 0.1. A learnable class token is prepended to the token sequence, and its output representation is used as the shared feature for downstream prediction. Both the classification and regression heads are implemented as two-layer MLPs with a dropout rate of 0.5. The classification branch outputs four logits corresponding to Non-contact , Single-finger , Scroll , and Pinch , while the regression branch predicts the normalized 2D interaction coordinates ( x , y ) (x,y) .
blocks.zh: 交互模块由三个编码层所组成的轻量级变形器. 每层使用8个注意头,向导扩展比为4,GELU活化,辍学率为0.1. 一个可学习的类符号被准备到符号序列,其输出表现被作为下游预测的共同特征. 分类和回归头作为两个层次的MLP执行,辍学率为0.5。 分类分支输出出与非接触,单指,斯克罗和平克对应的4个对数,而回归分支则预测正态的2D相互作用坐标(x,y)(x,y).

blocks.en: The deployed model contains approximately 89M parameters, striking a practical balance between representational capacity and inference efficiency. Despite jointly solving three tasks—touch contact detection, gesture classification, and absolute position regression—the model runs efficiently on a Mac mini with an M4 Pro chip used in our user study, achieving an average inference latency of 7.2 ms per frame. This corresponds to a theoretical throughput of over 100 Hz, which is sufficient to fully match the refresh rate of the current camera pipeline. Therefore, the model inference stage does not constitute the primary bottleneck of the system. Instead, it provides enough computational headroom for stable real-time interaction, ensuring that continuous palm-writing and multi-finger manipulations can be processed with low perceived delay. These findings support the practicality of our model design for deployment in interactive, low-latency scenarios.
blocks.zh: 部署的模式包含大约89M参数,在代表能力和推断效率之间达成实际平衡。 尽管该模型共同解决了三项任务——触摸接触检测、手势分类和绝对位置回归——但是,它在Mac迷你机上高效地运行,在我们的用户研究中使用了M4 Pro芯片,实现了每个帧平均推断空隙为7.2 ms. 这相当于超过100赫兹的理论吞吐量,这足以充分匹配目前相机管的刷新速率. 因此,模型推论阶段并不构成系统的主要瓶颈. 取而代之的是,它为稳定的实时互动提供了足够的计算头室,确保了连续的掌上写作和多指操纵可以被低感的延迟处理. 这些结论支持了我们在互动、低相关性情况下部署的模式设计的可行性。

blocks.en: A.2. Data Augmentation
blocks.zh: A.2. 数据增强

blocks.en: To improve robustness under practical use conditions, we apply data augmentation to simulate three common sources of variation in wrist-worn deployment. First, because the wrist-mounted camera may be slightly tilted during wearing, input images are randomly rotated within [ − 10 ∘ , 10 ∘ ] [-10^{\circ},10^{\circ}] . Second, because the relative placement between the camera and the bottom of the palm may vary, we apply random translation with a maximum relative offset of 0.1 in both horizontal and vertical directions. Third, because ambient illumination may change across environments, we randomly adjust image brightness and contrast with an offset factor of 0.2. These augmentations improve robustness to small pose perturbations and lighting variation in real-world use.
A.3. Training Details
blocks.zh: A.3. 培训详情

blocks.en: All experiments are conducted on an NVIDIA GeForce RTX 4090 GPU with 24GB VRAM. The original image resolution is 1920 × 1080 1920\times 1080 , and all images are resized to 224 × 224 224\times 224 for training and inference. The model is trained using the Adam optimizer with an initial learning rate of 1 × 10 − 4 1\times 10^{-4} , weight decay of 1 × 10 − 4 1\times 10^{-4} , and batch size of 160. Training runs for up to 100 epochs with ReduceLROnPlateau for adaptive learning-rate scheduling and early stopping to mitigate overfitting.

blocks.en: A.4. System Workflow
blocks.zh: A.4. 系统工作流程

blocks.en: Fig. 9 illustrates the workflow: the user wears a wristband that illuminates the palm with infrared light and performs interactions using either a single finger or multiple fingers. Captured images are processed by a multi-task Transformer network to simultaneously predict the touch contact state, gesture class (i.e., single-finger, scroll, or pinch), and the absolute position. When contact is detected, the system applies different interaction logic based on the gesture class: for single-finger mode, the system renders points on the canvas to simulate a realistic writing experience; for multi-finger gestures, the system maps the predicted coordinates to scrolling or zooming commands, enabling continuous spatial manipulation.

blocks.en: Fingertip positions are tracked using Google’s MediaPipe ( Zhang et al., 2020 ) , a robust keypoint detection method widely used in hand pose research ( Kyu et al., 2024 ; Lee et al., 2024a ; Devrio and Harrison, 2022 ) . Compared with reflective-marker-based optical tracking systems ( Dezfuli et al., 2012 ; Wang et al., 2015b ) , this markerless approach avoids visual artifacts in the wrist-mounted IR images and better preserves realistic bare-hand interaction conditions.

blocks.en: B.3. Collection Procedure
blocks.zh: B.3. 收集程序

blocks.en: Data collection was conducted in quiet indoor settings at different times of day (morning, afternoon, and evening), with the devices placed in different locations within the room. The study included 9 sessions: 6 single-finger sessions (2 areas × \times 3 modes), 2 multi-finger sessions (Scroll and Pinch), and 1 non-contact session.
blocks.zh: 数据收集工作在不同时间(上午、下午和晚上)在室内安静的环境中进行,设备放在房间的不同位置。 研究包括9个会:6个单指会(2个区×\times 3个模式),2个多指会(Scroll and Pinch),1个非接触会.

blocks.en: For single-finger sessions, participants performed serpentine sliding patterns. Interactions in the palm area included both longitudinal and transverse motions, whereas the finger area was limited to longitudinal sliding because of finger gaps. Unlike PalmGesture ( Wang et al., 2015b ) , we allowed participants to adopt comfortable finger pitch angles. For the two multi-finger sessions, interactions were restricted to the palm surface. To preserve ecological validity, we did not impose strict pose constraints; instead, participants performed gestures according to their natural habits, mimicking common touchpad interactions. The non-contact session collected negative samples such as hovering and random gestures to help distinguish valid touches from false positives.
blocks.zh: 就单指会议而言,与会者采用蛇纹滑行模式。 棕榈树地区的相互作用包括纵向运动和相向运动,而指部由于手指间隙而仅限于纵向滑动。 与PalmGesture(Wang等,2015b.)不同,我们允许参与者采用舒适的指投角. 对于两个多指的会话,互动仅限于掌上表面. 为了维护生态的有效性,我们没有施加严格的限制;相反,参与者根据其自然习惯作出姿态,模仿普通的触摸板相互作用。 非接触会集了诸如徘徊和随机手势等负面样本来帮助区分有效触摸与假阳性.

blocks.en: We explicitly excluded force-sensing resistors (FSRs) ( Mollyn and Harrison, 2024 ) for ground-truth collection. In pilot tests, FSRs introduced visual occlusion and were insufficiently sensitive to the light-touch interactions typical in our scenarios. To ensure coordinate consistency, participants aligned their palms within the 3D-printed groove relative to the AprilTag markers, with the palm center defined as the origin. During capture, users wore the device without an outer case to avoid occlusion and were encouraged to flex their wrists within an approximate range of ± 30 ∘ \pm 30^{\circ} to increase pose diversity while maintaining palm-plane visibility.
blocks.zh: 我们明确排除了强感抗震器(FSRs)(Molyn and Harrison, 2024)用于地面真实收集. 在试点测试中,FSR引入了视觉闭塞,对于我们情景中典型的轻触相互作用不够敏感. 为确保协调一致性,参与者在相较于"AprilTag"标记的3D打印地沟内调整了手掌,将手掌中心定义为发源地. 在捕捉过程中,用户穿戴没有外壳的装置来避免被遮住,被鼓励将手腕伸展到大约±30~\pm 30~~Circ}以在保持掌上飞机能见度的同时提高造型的多样性.

This stage established only the mapping between anatomical locations and digit labels and did not calibrate the PalmSpace sensing model itself.

blocks.en: C.3. Handwriting Task User Study
blocks.zh: C.3. 手写任务用户研究

blocks.en: Handwritten character input requires extremely high accuracy in finger touch detection and absolute finger positioning, as even small deviations can render text visually unrecognizable. Therefore, we conducted a handwriting input experiment to assess continuous input efficiency.
blocks.zh: 手写字符输入需要极高的精度指触检测和绝对指定位,因为即使是小偏差也能使文本无法识别. 因此,我们进行了笔迹输入实验,以评估连续输入效率。

blocks.en: C.3.1. Task and Procedure
blocks.zh: C.3.1. 任务和程序

blocks.en: We selected the 10 digits (0-9) and 26 uppercase letters (A-Z) as input tasks. Each participant was randomly assigned 20 characters to write sequentially following GUI prompts, using their preferred palm posture. Thanks to advancements in VLM (Vision Language Model) technology, instead of training a dedicated model, we employed GPT-4o ( OpenAI, 2024 ) for recognition. We used GPT-4o for its robustness to scale/rotation and direct structured output, unlike OCR models (e.g., Tesseract ( Google Inc. and contributors, 2025 ) and Paddle ( Baidu Inc., 2025 ) ), which are sensitive to scale/rotation and need complex tuning. For the touchscreen, participants rewrote the same 20 characters. In total, 12 × \times 2 × \times 20 = 480 characters were collected.
blocks.zh: 我们选择了10个数字(0-9)和26个大写字母(A-Z)作为输入任务. 每个参与者被随机指定20个字符,按照图形界面提示按顺序写出,使用他们喜欢的掌上姿势. 由于VLM(Vision Language Model)技术的进步,我们没有培训专门的模型,而是使用GPT-4o(OpenAI,2024)进行表彰. 我们使用GPT-4o来进行规模/旋转和直接结构化输出,这与OCR模型不同(例如:魔方(Google Inc.和贡献者,2025年)和Paddle(Baidu Inc.,2025年)),后者对规模/旋转敏感并需要复杂的调谐. 对于触摸屏,参与者重写相同的20个字符. 共收录了12个××分2个×分20个=480个字符.

blocks.en: C.3.2. Results

In the handwriting experiment, PalmSpace achieved an average recognition accuracy of 92.5%, with 26 of the 36 characters recognized at 100%. The confusion matrix is shown in Fig. 13(a) . However, some characters still exhibited significant confusion cases, particularly the digit ‘0,’ which was often misidentified as the similarly shaped letters ‘D’ or ‘O’. Successfully recognized example results are shown in Fig. 13(b) , where most users adopted a landscape orientation of the palm as the writing surface.
blocks.zh: 在笔迹实验中,PalmSpace实现了92.5%的平均识别精度,36个字符中有26个被100%识别. 图13(a)显示了混淆矩阵。 然而,有些字符仍然显示出明显的混淆情况,特别是数字 " 0 " ,常常被误认为是类似形状的字母 " D " 或 " O " 。 图13(b)显示了成功公认的实例结果,其中大多数用户采用了棕榈为写出表面的地貌取向。

blocks.en: For comparison, touchscreen input achieved 94.58% accuracy. Statistical analysis (Shapiro-Wilk and repeated-measures ANOVA) showed no significant difference between the two methods ( F 1 , 11 = 1.21 , p = 0.295 F_{1,11}=1.21,p=0.295 ). PalmSpace’s slightly lower mean accuracy can be attributed to palm curvature, which makes it harder to maintain stable strokes than on a flat touchscreen.

blocks.en: Overall, PalmSpace demonstrated handwriting performance comparable to gold-standard devices (i.e., touchscreens), confirming its potential for precise, free-space handwriting input. In addition, as shown in Table 1 , it is calibration-free (users could use the system immediately without individual setup) and supports 2D finger tracking and touch detection for high-precision natural handwriting, unlike systems that constrain users to continuous stroke input ( He et al., 2025b ) .

blocks.en: C.4. Qualitative Feedback

blocks.en: Participants consistently reported that PalmSpace offered stronger proprioceptive cues than the touchscreen during eyes-free use (Fig. 13(c) ). They also mentioned that PalmSpace may be especially promising in relaxed or immersive scenarios such as large-screen viewing or mixed-reality interaction, where taking out a phone or shifting visual attention to a display would be undesirable.

blocks.en: E.1. Daytime Data Collection and Protocol
blocks.zh: 页:1 日间数据收集和协议

blocks.en: The daytime experiment was designed to directly assess the model’s generalization capabilities in natural outdoor settings. Data collection was performed at locations arranged with the users, encompassing a variety of environments such as sunny and overcast conditions, parks, streets, and balconies. In total, 14 sets of in-the-wild data were collected, comprising 10,388 contact images and 3,514 non-contact images . During acquisition, participants were instructed to touch the entire capturable area of their palm without constraints on finger posture to simulate real-world usage. Fig. 14 illustrates sample images from these scenarios.

blocks.en: E.3. Note on Nighttime Ground Truth
blocks.zh: E.3. 关于夜间地面真相的说明

blocks.en: In the nighttime scenario, standard RGB-based visual ground truth methods were found to be unreliable. Specifically, MediaPipe’s hand tracking performance degrades significantly when ambient illuminance falls below 5 lux, leading to inaccurate keypoint detection. Therefore, the nighttime evaluation relied on the task completion time of the Fitts’ Law study rather than direct geometric error measurement.
blocks.zh: 在夜间情景中,标准基于RGB的视觉地面真伪方法被发现不可靠. 具体地说,MediaPipe的手追踪性能在环境亮度低于5克时会显著地下降,导致不准确的键点检测. 因此,夜间评估取决于Fitts的任务完成时间。 法学研究而不是直接几何误差测量.
